reason: The cited lines show the tool validates a user-provided path, reads a host filesystem directory with fs.readdir, and returns the directory entry names. That supports SECRET because it exposes host filesystem metadata. There is no arbitrary code execution and no delivery of agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination, so HOSTEXEC and SINK are not supported. The lines do not establish that the directory entries are attacker-controllable, so UNTRUSTED is insufficient.
